patterns: The 'famous IP, but it's 197x' format peaks on day five: techhalla's The Avengers 1972 (134.5K views, 2,338 likes), Dragon Ball 1971 (92.3K) and Harry Potter 1973 (89.0K), each with ~390-430 bookmarks. Short title + one emoji, the clip does all the work.

Fable 5.2 moves from 'coding model' to 'director': EHuanglu's 'can direct better films than most directors now' (54.8K views, 507 bookmarks); outside the watchlist pounddz's Hollywood-level animation (45.4K, 784 bookmarks) and luccacerf's 3-hour character workflow (25.5K, 461 bookmarks). Bookmark-to-like ratios near 1:1 or higher = people save workflows.

Seedance 2.5 native 4K launch day: platform posts from Pika (109.9K) and Venice (107.2K) took the reach, but creator tests got weaker numbers (AIWarper 7.7K, maxescu under 3.6K). The launch itself travels; a plain 'it's gorgeous' test does not.
Blockout to final shot is the rising craft topic: ComfyUI's breakdown of what Seedance 2.5 and MiniMax H3 pick up from a 3D blockout got 13.4K views and 213 bookmarks.
News recaps keep minchoi on the board (4 posts between 12.0K and 28.8K, led by the Grok Bot 1.0 quote at 28.8K), while early-access image-model tests (MiniMax H3 Image, Seedream 5.5) stayed under 5K.

drafts.video_tip: 15-20s 70s Technicolor montage: strongest wide shot (the red-and-white rocket, Marlinspike Hall, a Brussels street) in the first 2s, heavy grain and halation, 1.85 letterbox, end on a vintage French title card. 3-step how-to in the first reply.

drafts.draft_en:
I pushed one VFX shot through Seedance 2.5 in native 4K.

Then I zoomed in 400%.

Here's what held up, and what fell apart 👇
drafts.video_tip: 10-12s: full-frame shot for 2s, then hard punch-ins on 3 detail areas (hair, smoke, edges) with a 4K/400% label, finish on a side-by-side with a 1080p render. Put the honest pros and cons list in the reply.

drafts.draft_en:
Gray blockout → final shot.

3 minutes of geometry. The rest is AI VFX.

Full breakdown in the reply 👇
drafts.video_tip: 8-10s wipe transition from untextured blockout to final graded shot, synced on a beat; loop-friendly. Reply with the 4 steps (blockout, reference frame, video pass, comp/grade).

drafts.draft_en:
I let Claude Fable 5.2 write the shot list.

I did the VFX.

So who directed this?
drafts.video_tip: 20-25s mini-sequence with the shot-list text overlaid as a typed caption per shot (SHOT 03, low angle, dusk) so viewers see the script become images. Screenshot of the full shot list in the reply.

drafts.draft_en:
Saturday Challenge 🎞️

Take any classic and make it look like it was shot in 1972.

Post yours below. I'll break down my favorite 3 next week.
drafts.video_tip: 6-8s teaser: one modern frame flipping into a 70s graded version (grain, warm cast, soft halation), with a 'SATURDAY CHALLENGE' title card. Pin it for the weekend.
